handoffs.what: Add `node _harness/probe_kit_hue.mjs --live` (64 slots: sig >= 0.5, team light <= 0.35 on a3/ult) and `--skins --live` to the integration gate. Burdam can come back 'not measured' in a full sweep (no cast event in its batch); `--kits burdam` measures it cleanly.

Ult first-beat core is below 2.3 on 10 ults (probe_combat_polish ult --ults all: hesmi 1.93, marund 1.66, nurrow 1.94, kemdo 2.13, sukri 2.14, dunsom/ervet/odrum/burdam/vashil 2.24-2.26). Raising point-light intensity does not move the measure. Next try: a short signature-or-companion light-style ground decal (emissive ~4, life ~0.2 s) at the beat inside 0.5 x the lift radius, or a generic core glow in vfx/screen.ts pulse. Also open: victim-box white at Vashil 0.432 and Lisvel 0.376, and ulkro_long_evening ult skin sig 0.261.

content/strings.en.json: "settings.video.ao.opt.2" says "Full resolution", but ao 2 is now half-resolution AO with finer ('High') samples (src/render/post.ts, perf PERF-C1). Rename it to e.g. "Fine". Also wire first-run calibration: on the first boot at Home, call `await renderer.calibrate()` (returns {preset:'high'|'medium'|'low', frames, p50Ms, p95Ms}; keep calling render(dt) while it is pending). Store `preset` as the first-run video preset in place of the fixed 'high' default (src/session/settings.ts:65). If it is not 'high', show the VALE-styled notice linking Settings > Video.

Add to the integration gate: `node _harness/perf_1080.mjs --prod --match-seeds 7,11,23` (it now includes the gpubound, calibrate and memmaps steps), plus `node _harness/probe_dynres_metal.ts` (also picked up by npm run probe). Match peak seed 23, rot 10 FAILS: 721k triangles at 1322.8 s (19 s over 500k), with crowd body 141k/14 draws and crowd outline 133k/7 draws in a late base push, and 41 programs (> 40) at 9.4 s from the rotated fighters' extra materials (gem_chimglass x2, glasshorn_dawnglass, dialwren_matte). My changes did not cause this: the gate never ran that seed before. It needs a crowd outline LOD / crowd-count cap and a program audit. The critic b4 real-time number needs an idle machine (load < 3); the load stayed at 12-270 all session.

The PERF-C2 Home footprint gate (perf_1080 memmaps) does not include audio, because the bench plays none. Renderer+GPU at Home is 1120-1286 MB against the 2500 MB budget, so your ~86 MB of decoded audio at Home fits. Keep it budgeted.

Dunsom lantern under his own bar (dunsom-lantern-nameplate / bar-clearance gate). In idle the x_lantern part is half under the bar plate or level chip at 1 of 8 facings (12.5 % > 10 %): facing 7, lantern at x -0.83 m (-63 px, under the level chip) at equivalent height 2.32 m with the anchor at 2.40 m. Its circle of equivalent heights (1.0-3.2 m) means no engine anchor up to +1.1 m clears it. In art/blender/fighters/dunsom.py idle, either hang the lantern about 0.25 m further out from the body axis on the crook side (so at facing 7 it sits beyond -1.06 m, outside the chip), or tilt the crook 8-10 degrees outward as the fighter review proposed. Verify with `node _harness/probe_bar_clearance.ts` (needs dunsom idle <= 10 % at 31 m and 28.5 m). The probe exits 1 until then.

Body heights at the closing review's 28.5 m and 1080p (node _harness/probe_camera.ts --only heights; _harness/_reports/fw_CW1_camera_heights.json) are under the 105-130 px gauge for Ilsheta 90-91, Lisvel 99-100 and Nurrow base 98 (Noon Fair and Shadeprint are 105). Marund Long Evening is 130.4 (just over). At the owner's default 31 m every value is about 8 % lower. If these builds are not meant to read small, raise art.scale (for example Lisvel x1.06, Nurrow base to match its skins) and re-run the probe with --gate-heights.

Body heights at 28.5 m / 1080p (node _harness/probe_camera.ts --only heights) are under the 105-130 px gauge for Sukri 87, Rishal 95-100 and Odrum 99-102. Sukri would need about x1.21 art.scale to reach 105, so if her small build is intended, record a ruling in fixwaves/owner_rulings.md instead. Note: the renderer now measures runRef from each run clip (src/render/stride.ts), so art.runRefSpeed no longer drives stride and needs no edit.

Possible input bug, or a harness artefact: in `node _harness/probe_input_latency.mjs --orders 12 --kinds attack,windupMove --tag attack` (_harness/_reports/fw_CW1_input_latency_attack.json), right-clicking the parked enemy fighter, 3.4-5.8 m away, visibleMask 3, alive, issued a ground move (wmark--move) in 12/12 orders. That includes orders 0-1, where renderer.pickEntity at the same screen point returned the foe 0.1-0.5 s before the click. In an earlier run with a melee fighter at 1.2-1.9 m, attack clicks did resolve (wmark--attack). Check src/input/controller.ts rightDown -> entityAt/enemy (ptr coordinates vs the pick, e.targetable) for teleported enemies.

Add to the integration gate: `node _harness/probe_camera.ts` (rig, foot slip <= 10 %, turn; heights WARN, or --gate-heights), `node _harness/probe_bar_clearance.ts` (expected FAIL on Dunsom's lantern until CW6's art change, and it is picked up by npm run probe), and `node _harness/probe_input_latency.mjs` (real client, heavy slot: marker p95 <= 2 frames, motion p95 <= 2 ticks + 1 frame, plus the live camera checks). overlay_regress --q high,low PASS after these changes.

CW1 regression set after this package. typecheck clean. Strict `npm run content:check`: OK, 0 warnings. `node _harness/overlay_regress.mjs --q high,low`: PASS. `node _harness/perf_1080.mjs --prod --q high,low` (fw_CW1_perf_polish.json) prints GATE FAIL on one item only: the match-peak triangle count is 534,665 > 500k at game 1749.7 s on seed 7 (4 s over; actors 310k/131 draws in a late base push). This is the same crowd-peak class as the seed 23 handoff. The cause is the sim, not render: the seed 7 match used to end at 1162 s and now runs to 1800 s. Everything else passes: High 57.7 fps, Low 58.8 fps, gpubound, calibrate, memmaps Home 1329 MB, 0 late programs. The fix is still a crowd outline LOD or crowd-count cap. Also add `node _harness/probe_camjump.mjs` (heavy slot; 0 bodies missing after a focus jump) to the integration gate. Correction: commit f77c7b03 says 'core >= 2.3 on 10/16'; the measured count in fw_W1_combat_polish_fw_CW1_polish_c.json is 9/16. C2's x2.3 core for Hesmi, Kemdo, Dunsom, Nurrow and Sukri cannot be reached with the tint kept: the lifted ground clips at about luma 218 on warm ground after the grade. Reaching it means letting the core go near-white, which conflicts with the victim-box white gate (luma > 225 and chroma < 30). Rule which way the gauge should go: a lower core target, or a 2-frame near-white allowance.

`node _harness/value_probe.mjs --report fw_CW1_value_polish.json` (B5) exits 0 but prints FAIL on three environment lines. RIFT high env180 'other' is 0.152 % of env, RIFT low 0.158 %. BRIDGE low frame p99 is 165 (> 160). The lamps are 0.000 % of the frame, and the BRIDGE flame I brightened covers about 333 px, far too few to move a frame p99, so this most likely comes from the world art. Please check your landmarks and props. FRAY lamp flames (env m-5): the shot_ambient in-play flame reading at the fray spot covers 26,941 px and does not move when the flame changes. Pick a flame spot where the lamp is the only thing that changes, or move the lamps, if the flame band needs gating there.

No change: Dunsom's lantern is still half-covered in 12.5 % of idle cases at 31 m and at 28.5 m (probe_bar_clearance FAIL). The art fix from the earlier handoff (hang it about 0.25 m further out, or tilt the crook 8-10 degrees outward) is still needed.

kemdo-M1 pose half: Kemdo's bar anchor already sits at the clearance maximum (+0.60 m, 3.07 m), so it can rise no further. Lowering the lens to about 1.85 m in guard, idle and stunned (art/blender/fighters/kemdo.py) would let the computed anchor drop back down.
